question: By whose agency and will does the yoginī named Icchā extend up to māyā?
premises: The extent reaches up to māyā by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī named Icchā, with the siddhas, extends up to māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The precise syntactic relation between siddhaiḥ and māyāntaṃ is ambiguous.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, with the siddhas, reaches up to māyā by supreme will.
